translations.7d4df8cf53575d4ffcbdc0ee: Write a pair of examples—one good answer and one bad one—for the most common case of your task.
translations.153fa0c0f2dcc310cd955177: The pair works when the difference is visible in one line. Salon example: the good one says “cut + blow-dry for R$ 90, book via the link”; the bad one says “can’t-miss prices, come check it out.” The bad one is generic and doesn’t include the data the customer wants.
